name: agent-issues-workspace
description: Workspace root for agent-issues: shared core, CLI, site, and deployable API.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @agent-issues/core build && pnpm --filter @agent-issues/api-local build && pnpm --filter @agent-issues/api-pg build && pnpm --filter @agent-issues/mcp-server build && pnpm --filter @agent-issues/site build && pnpm --filter agent-issues build && pnpm --filter agent-issues-mcp-provider build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @agent-issues/core build && pnpm --filter @agent-issues/api-local build && pnpm --filter @agent-issues/api-pg build && pnpm --filter @agent-issues/mcp-server build && pnpm -r typecheck
